name: Story: what you can send, Ward on the OPS phone (SC12)
notes: STORY steg 6, the morning act. Started by morning_telex when the search is over and the player was not taken. The old SC12 'What you can send' (S47Chapter5, Ward on the Mesa Diner payphone: Reyes reads the three sources and the first limit, Ward reads them back, the document sc12_warning) on Freeform's OPS phone at SARO (the old SC11 contract: Ward calls on the ordinary phone; Dale's line is silent). Ward has no recorded voice: her lines are text, as the phone in night_room6. Left out: the drive to the diner and its payphone, the deputy at the counter with his patrol sheet and the wall map P13 (the old chapter's own people and table; new characters would be a new mechanic), and the reply as a choice (the pack has no Ward scene).

beats.text: The OPS phone rings once and you have it before the second. Dr. Ward, from her own office: I read the telex. All of it.
You read her the three sources off the sheets: H-1, S-11, and ours, SARO-3. First limit for all three: 05:29:47.
Ward: H-1, S-11, SARO-3. 05:29:47. I have it written down, with the time.
Ward: Get the originals to the courier. Don't wait for me. She hangs up.
Read to Dr. Ward on the OPS phone: H-1 (Hondo), S-11 (Site 11), SARO-3 (ours). First limit for all three: 05:29:47. Read back correctly. She has the time of the call.
